description: Send the open coach the words you are saying, so its picture's mouth moves and it blinks with them. In the internal voice (the coach's voice unless the person chose one of GoldAvatar's on the view) the view makes no sound: you say the words yourself, in your own voice, in this chat, and at the same time send them here in small chunks, about 5 words each, in the order you say them. Chunks sent while the picture is still moving wait their turn. Optional cues (GoldAvatar's show_frame, action, head, set_caption, speaking, mouth_shapes, blink, idle, auto_revert) go at sentence or beat boundaries. While a GoldSeam service is being called, keep talking with the person about the process and about how their answers are affirming, in a motivational voice, and send those words too. The view shows the words beside the picture as it moves through them. speaker is claude when omitted: the view shows Claude's own picture (the Claude bot); speaker avatar shows the coach's own picture (GoldAvatar's avatar) for those words. Where the person chose one of GoldAvatar's voices on the view, the view sounds the words it is sent in that voice. view switches the picture now (claude, avatar, or camera: the person's own camera, which their browser asks them to allow); whoever speaks next takes it back. Use the coach_id open_coach returned. The answer says what was queued; a queued chunk is not evidence the person saw it.

arguments.description: The cue's own arguments, as GoldAvatar's tool of that name takes them

reply_to.description: Optional: the message this answers, when it came through the coach

speaker.description: Who says it: claude (you, in Claude's own picture; the default) or avatar (the coach's own picture shows for the words)

text.description: The words you are saying now: a small chunk of your sentence, about 5 words

view.description: Optional: the picture to show now: avatar, claude (the Claude bot) or camera (the person's own camera)
